# Output

![Output function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/connectivity/connectivity.web_services.output.svg)

[Connectivity functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Author Web Service response bodies, headers, cookies and output stream operations with their declared data types.

## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Set HTTP Response MIME Type.vi](output/set_mime_type.md) | Sets the MIME type of the current HTTP response. |
| [Set HTTP Response Code.vi](output/set_http_code.md) | Sets the HTTP status code returned to the client. |
| [Set HTTP Redirect.vi](output/set_redirect.md) | Sets an HTTP redirect for the current streaming response. |
| [Set HTTP Header.vi](output/set_header.md) | Assigns a header field in the current streaming HTTP response. |
| [Write Response.vi](output/write_response.md) | Writes response text for an HTTP method configured to stream its output. |
| [Flush Output.vi](output/flush_output.md) | Sends buffered HTTP response data to the socket. |
